text: General Information Courses are divided into foundational, intermediate, and advanced classes. Students who successfully complete the program will be awarded University of Jinan certificates. Courses Offered •Required Courses: Basic Chinese, Listening Comprehension, Conversation, Reading, Composition, etc. • Selective Courses: Professional Chinese, Ancient Chinese Language, Contemporary Chinese, Chinese Classics, Philosophy, History of Chinese Culture, Chinese Calligraphy, Martial Arts, Chinese Traditional Handicrafts, etc. • Lessons can also be arranged according to the specific needs of the students. Teaching Arrangements • Students will study 3 hours every day from Monday to Friday. • Term trips will be arranged to relevant historical and cultural sites. Characteristics and Advantages Student tutors (majoring in Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language) will be assigned to help language learners with their Chinese language studies.
